availability_verbatim: Anybody can join via Connexus Association + $5 donation; free in select MN/IL/OH/WI counties

requirements.verbatim: Make 15 debit card purchases or accumulate $500 in debit card spending
Make one monthly deposit of at least $500 from either a direct deposit or an ACH deposit
open a new Xtraordinary Checking Account with promo code XTRABONUS

churn.limit_language_verbatim: not valid for existing members with any Connexus Checking Account currently open or closed on or after 7/1/2025

superseded_values.evidence: Update 6/16/26: Maximum bonus is now $250 (previously $300) and tiers are worse
$15,000 and over will earn $250 (previously only required $10,000+ for $300)

notes: Requirements must be met for two month-end periods (not necessarily consecutive) within 120 days of account opening; bonus is based on averaging the average daily balance from the first two qualifying monthly periods. The Fine Print section retains an older, unreconciled tier table ($999.99 and below/$1,000-$4,999.99/$5,000-$9,999.99/$10,000+ -> $0/$100/$200/$300) that appears to be un-updated boilerplate from an earlier version of this offer; I used the Offer section's explicitly-marked current figures (which reference 'previously' amounts) as ground truth. Separate Inactivity Fee (not an ETF) applies to accounts with no activity in 90 days and balance under $100.
